title: Missed breaths and distress on pressure support
summary: A 69-year-old man with COPD on pressure support has many breathing efforts that the ventilator does not respond to.
rationale: Severe expiratory flow limitation and a high spontaneous rate trap gas; the patient must overcome auto-PEEP before the ventilator senses a breath, so many efforts are wasted. Correct management has two parts that work together: treat the obstruction (bronchodilator) and set applied PEEP at about 75-85% of the measured auto-PEEP (here 8.8 at PEEP 4, so PEEP 7). In a flow-limited chest (waterfall) PEEP below the critical closing pressure barely adds to total PEEP, so the missed efforts clear without more hyperinflation; PEEP above the auto-PEEP (here 14) does add to it. Headless engine check, the case ending at 18 min: untouched by 2 min: PaCO2 70, pH 7.27, SpO2 96%, Pplat 16, auto-PEEP 8.8, total PEEP 12.8, SBP 143; untouched by 18 min (case ended deteriorated): PaCO2 134, pH 7.07, SpO2 20%, Pplat 15, auto-PEEP 8.3; reasonable management (bronchodilator, PEEP 7) by 18 min: PaCO2 45, pH 7.41, SpO2 98%, Pplat 18, auto-PEEP 0.6, total PEEP 7.6, SBP 143; typical mistake (PEEP 14, above the auto-PEEP) by 18 min: PaCO2 50, pH 7.38, Pplat 25, total PEEP 17.8; other arms at 18 min: bronchodilator alone PaCO2 51 / pH 7.37 / auto-PEEP 2.4; PEEP 7 alone PaCO2 95 / pH 7.17 / auto-PEEP 7.9, so the missed efforts clear (rate 39) but breaths stay shallow and the patient tires; sedation (case ended deteriorated) PaCO2 135, pH 7.06, SpO2 4%. The bronchodilator is the main driver, PEEP at about 80% of auto-PEEP helps on its own but only together with it restores a safe pattern, and PEEP above auto-PEEP buys gas exchange at the price of about 10 cmH2O more total PEEP and 7 cmH2O more plateau pressure; the untouched arm is deliberately unstable, as in the base case.

retestsMistake.clinicalFocus: Ineffective triggering from auto-PEEP: treat the airway obstruction (bronchodilator) and set applied PEEP at about 75-85% of the measured auto-PEEP; in a flow-limited patient this clears missed efforts without adding to hyperinflation. PEEP above the auto-PEEP worsens hyperinflation; more pressure support or sedation do not help

source: The Ventilator Book 3e (obstructive disease / auto-PEEP chapters, numbers unverified); Marino ICU Book 2025 (severe asthma and COPD exacerbation chapters, numbers unverified); Nunn & Lumb 9e (airway resistance chapter, unverified); Appendini L, et al. Physiologic effects of PEEP in COPD with auto-PEEP. Am J Respir Crit Care Med 1994;149:1069-76. Flow limitation 11.5 cmH2O and rate 28 are teaching assumptions (unverified); waterfall PEEP behaviour after Ranieri/Appendini (numbers unverified).

changes.vignette: Male 69, 175 cm, 72 kg. PSV 13 over PEEP 4, cycle 25%, trigger 2 L/min.

anatomicDeadSpaceMl.reason: Keeps some alveolar ventilation at Vt near 170 mL, so the untouched arm does not drop to zero alveolar ventilation

patient.presentingStory: Day 4 of ventilation for a COPD exacerbation, on pressure support for 3 hours. The nurse sees him pulling hard with chest-wall movement that the ventilator does not follow. He is sweaty and tachycardic.
patient.history: Severe COPD, FEV1 30% predicted, chronic retainer. Full escalation.
